plays.name: Pull In Trigger
plays.desc:
An opening drive setup where we aim to catch the first pull in during a strong momentum. Strongest in the first few minutes of the opening session, with the potential to entry on the first HL, but safer following a break of HOD. 

Can also occur after the opening reversal reclaiming EMA pockets and VWAP

Target: RR preference or trailing 1m HL

bullish: Multiple Symbol / Sector Confluence is a Plus
Trend is stronger with wide EMA pocket when VWAP below EMA50
bearish: Prior Resistance Nearby (PMH / PDH / Multiple R)

rules: Entry on 1m pullback after opening drive with volume
Must be above PMH / PDH for long bias
SQQQ below EMA pocket confirms market tailwind
Stop below 1m pull in candle low
plays.notes: Best when multiple symbols in sector moving together. Break above / holding above 4HR PCH adds conviction.

plays.name: Hitchiker
plays.desc:
A continuation setup in the opening session from SMB Capital. Price action opens up with a strong drive, then consolidates in what appears to be similar to an ascending triangle pattern before breaking HOD into a strong momentum trend. 

Target: RR preference or trailing after letting the trade play out throughout the morning session.

bullish: Multiple Symbol / Sector Confluence is a Plus
bearish: Prior Resistance Nearby (PMH / PDH / Multiple R)

rules: Ride the continuation alongside a leading name
Must be above PMH / PDH for long bias
SQQQ below EMA pocket confirms market tailwind
plays.notes: Identical criteria to 1m HL / 1m Pull In for now — edit as needed.

plays.name: Base & Go
plays.desc:
A Pull In setup based on the 5m TF, where price action of a strong, trending, or lead bull name, pulls back to retest EMA12 & VWAP, before continuing another impulse wave higher than the high of day.

Sell Target: RR preference or high of day HH

bearish: 5m TC to the downside / 5m LH set

rules: 5m higher low must be confirmed — not just a pause
EMA12 retest = entry trigger
VWAP confluence / PA above VWAP adds conviction
Stop below 5m HL candle low
plays.notes: 5RSI Yellow appears in both rows — context-dependent caution flag. PA consolidation above the 0.5 retracement is a strong tell.

plays.name: Brunch Scalper

bullish: Wide EMA Pocket / VWAP Under EMA50

rules: Look for strong name continuation into the brunch session
Wide EMA pocket with VWAP under EMA50
5m PCH break above EMA12 = trigger
plays.notes: Red flags to be filled in. Mid-morning / brunch continuation play.

plays.name: Equilibrium
plays.desc:
A continuation play where price action tightens and squeeze before a breakout. 

Target: High of day continuation with option to trail. Usually results in a trending day.
rules: Clear tightening range H>L>LH>HL into a break
Consolidation taking place above EMA pockets
Multiple timeframes above EMA12 adds conviction
Declining volume on pullback confirms buyers in control

plays.name: Stair Step

bullish: More than 3 consecutive red LH candles
bearish: First 5m TC to the downside / 5m LH set

rules: Must see 3+ consecutive 5m candles forming higher lows
Stair step must break above EMA12 cleanly
EMA12 retest after break = entry trigger
Stop below most recent stair step low
plays.notes: HTF consolidation is a hard pass. First 5m TC to the downside invalidates the setup immediately.

plays.name: Inflection Point
rules: Entry must be on 1st or 2nd 5m candle at the inflection — not later
1m TC must break above prior 5m or 15m candle high as confirmation
Tight stop below the inflection candle low
plays.notes: Red flags to be filled in. Early entry setup — size conservatively.

plays.name: 236 Bull Flags
plays.desc:
A continuation setup in the opening session where price action opens strong, pulls back to consolidate above or at 0.236 fib retracement level and then continues to break to a higher high. This setup has potential to lead to a strong trending day, but also need to keep in mind higher time frames making sure 15m and 1hr are not at extreme OB levels. 

Target: 1:1

plays.name: Catalyst Momentum Drive
plays.desc:
A momentum play following a surge in price action from news. Requires quick response and filter of news to gauge continuation. The aim is to try to capture 1m HLs or 5m HLs into continuation. 

Target: Atleast a 3:1 RR.
